PART IB NATIONAL COMPANY LAW TRIBUNAL 10FB. Constitution of National
Company Law Tribunal.-
The Central Government shall, by notification in the Official Gazette, constitute a
Tribunal to be known as the National Company Law Tribunal to exercise and
discharge such powers and functions as are, or may be, conferred on it by or under
this Act or any other law for the time being in force.
10FC. Composition of Tribunal.-The Tribunal shall consist of a President and such
number of Judicial and Technical Members not exceeding sixty-two, as the Central
Government deems fit, to be appointed by that Government, by notification in the
Official Gazette.
10FD. Qualifications for appointment of President and Members.
(1) The Central Government shall appoint a person who has been, or is qualified to
be, a judge of a High Court as the President of the Tribunal.
(2) A person shall not be qualified for appointment as Judicial Member unless he-
